motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council instruct the Civil and Human Rights and Equity Department, with assistance from the Office of the City Attorney, and any other department as needed, to report, in 90 days, on the feasibility of establishing an Environmental Justice and Advocacy Advisory Commission designed to engage communities citywide on Los Angeles’ persistent environmental justice issues, foster sustainable education initiatives, promote equity in sustainable benefits, and to advise the Mayor and City Council on policy Recommendations. I FURTHER MOVE that the report includes recommendations for the prospective Commission to include a wide and diverse representation of community-based stakeholder organizations to inform the mission and bylaws, and to establish a process where prospective commissioners are appointed by the Mayor and City Council. PRESENTED BY Nook—” CM YSABEL JURADO Councilmember, 14th District SECONDED BY AUG 0 4 2026
